description: Find transit operators/agencies by name, near a point or within a bounding box, by country/region, or by Onestop ID. Returns each operator's Onestop ID, name, the agencies it covers, the places it serves, and the feeds it publishes. The entry point for "what transit runs here?". Transitland does not geocode place names — geocode a city to coordinates with openstreetmap_geocode first, then pass lat and lon (with an optional radius) or a bbox. Provide at least one of: search, lat+lon, bbox, onestop_id, or a place filter (adm0_name/adm1_name).

adm0_name.description: Filter to a country by full English name (e.g. "United States of America", "Germany"). Coarse — pair with search or geography to narrow.

adm1_name.description: Filter to a state/province/region by full name (e.g. "California"). Use with adm0_name.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (enrichment.cursor). Returns the next page after this internal ID.

bbox.description: Bounding box "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat" (e.g. "-122.5,37.7,-122.3,37.9"). Alternative to lat/lon/radius for area surveys. Cannot be combined with lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center (WGS84 decimal degrees). Requires lon. Transitland does not geocode — use openstreetmap_geocode to turn a place name into coordinates first.

limit.description: Maximum operators to return. Values above 100 apply the 100-result page cap with a notice. Page further with the after cursor.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center (WGS84 decimal degrees). Requires lat.

onestop_id.description: Operator Onestop ID (e.g. "o-9q9-bart") or internal integer ID, for a direct lookup. When set, other filters are ignored. For the complete record prefer transitland_get_operator.

radius.description: Search radius in meters around lat/lon (max 100,000). Operators are matched when their service area intersects the radius.

search.description: Full-text search over operator and agency names (e.g. "BART", "Sound Transit"). Upstream-ranked. Combine with a place filter to disambiguate common names.

name: transitland_find_operators

cursor.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page. Present only when more results exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_filter`: No search, coordinates, bbox, onestop_id, or place filter was provided (server-enforced guard — the API accepts unfiltered requests but returns a paginated global dump). `incomplete_point`: lat without lon or lon without lat. `rate_limited`: Transitland returned HTTP 429 (free-tier rate limit). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched (e.g. geocode-first reminder).

feeds.description: Feeds this operator publishes. The bridge to the open-data catalog — a GTFS_RT entry here means real-time departures may be available.

onestopId.description: Feed Onestop ID. Pass to transitland_find_feeds (operator_onestop_id) or look up directly.

spec.description: Feed spec: GTFS, GTFS_RT, GBFS, or MDS.

onestopId.description: Stable public Onestop ID (e.g. "o-9q9-bart"). Use for transitland_get_operator and as operator_onestop_id in find_feeds/find_routes.

places.description: Distinct places this operator serves, summarized from its agencies. Empty when unmapped.

city.description: City name. Null when the agency spans no single city.

shortName.description: Short name/abbreviation (e.g. "BART"). Null when the feed omits it.

wikidataId.description: Wikidata QID from source tags (e.g. "Q610120"), for cross-referencing wikidata-mcp-server. Null when absent.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: transitland-mcp-server: find operators
